scope: 24 natural-base ingredient entries including a separately identified C8/C10 MCT carrier; no finished-product labels, fitted thresholds or cohort outcomes.

interpretation.classes: Relative formulation starting estimates for comparable dose/context, not scientific ingredient facts or universal hair-fit rules.
interpretation.missing_evidence: Absent evidence is not medium. Every proposed default is an advisory inference from its listed evidence; very_low entries should be treated as unresolved for confident ranking.
interpretation.strength: moderate_indirect = comparative skin panel/material anchor; low = supplier description; very_low = weak non-comparative or imperfect-access evidence. These are estimate-support levels, not clinical evidence grades.
interpretation.global_exclusions: Do not infer concentration from INCI order, use antioxidant/FA richness as heaviness, or propagate intact-oil class into extracts, PEG/surfactants, hydrogenates, esters, waxes, alkanes or derivatives.
interpretation.hair_evidence: No entry has a verified standardized human-hair light/medium/rich sensory class. Skin feel, viscosity, spreading, hair penetration and protein loss remain different endpoints.

UNIVAR2018.title: EarthOil / EBInnov sensory profile study
UNIVAR2018.locator: PDF page 2 table; page 1 radar plots
UNIVAR2018.access: Public PDF text read; screenshot requested but image pixels unavailable through current web wrapper.
UNIVAR2018.supports: Comparative descriptions for named grades: almond/grapeseed light; apricot/baobab/moringa/macadamia intermediate; crude avocado greasy, refined avocado intermediate; hemp fluid; pomegranate more residual.
UNIVAR2018.limits: Skin assessment; panel size, dose, blinding and variability not disclosed in brochure. No numeric radar values transcribed. Not a hair ranking.

UNIVAR2022.title: EarthOil Vegetable Oils: Sensory and Fatty Acid Profiles
UNIVAR2022.supports: Updated comparative descriptions and grade differences; coconut melts/spreads on skin and has higher greasiness symbols than liquid oils.
UNIVAR2022.limits: Not independent replication of 2018. Light/intermediate words mostly omitted. Do not infer exact scores from symbol table.

IOI2022.title: IOI Oleo excipients for injectable formulations
IOI2022.access: Indexed full relevant text retrieved; subsequent PDF open returned internal error.
IOI2022.supports: MIGLYOL 810 N and 812 N C8/C10 triglycerides: approximately 28 and 30 mPa·s at 20°C; medium spreading. Different from the faster-spreading propylene-glycol diester.
IOI2022.limits: Pharmaceutical material grades and spreading language, not hair sensory.

IOIEXCIPIENTS2022.title: IOI Pharma Excipients 2022
IOIEXCIPIENTS2022.supports: C8/C10 ratios 70:30 and 60:40; 28/30 mPa·s at 20°C. MIGLYOL 829 is a different succinic triglyceride, approximately 260 mPa·s.
IOIEXCIPIENTS2022.limits: Do not transfer values to generic coconut oil, Triheptanoin or modified triglycerides.

MERCKCASTOR.title: Sigma-Aldrich castor oil 18722, refined DAB
MERCKCASTOR.limits: Temperature not stated beside viscosity in visible page; density separately specifies 20°C. Do not label viscosity as 20°C or compute a precise cross-source ratio.

JDDESERT.title: JD Jojoba Oil for clean cosmetics
JDDESERT.supports: Cold-pressed liquid wax; supplier describes little greasy residue on skin.
JDDESERT.limits: No disclosed comparative hair-weight method. Other efficacy claims on page not adopted.

O3PLAY2026.title: O&3 Beauty and Personal Care Trend Report: Ingredient Playbook 2026
O3PLAY2026.supports: Advisory sensory profiles across several oils and grades.
O3PLAY2026.limits: Marketing/formulation guidance, no panel method or uncertainty. Broad common names need exact-INCI corroboration. Not equivalent to Univar comparative experiment; generic supplier page copy can be inconsistent.

HALLARGAN.title: Hallstar Biochemica Argan Oil Refined ARG1
HALLARGAN.supports: Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil; refined oil described as non-greasy on skin.
HALLARGAN.limits: No neat-oil hair-weight panel reported. Appearance 'light yellow' is color, not sensory lightness.

HALLBABASSU.title: Hallstar Biochemica Babassu Oil Ultra Refined BB01
HALLBABASSU.supports: Orbignya Oleifera Seed Oil; soft solid below 24°C, melts on skin, supplier describes fast skin penetration.
HALLBABASSU.limits: Melting and skin penetration do not establish lightness on hair.

SOPHIMSUNFLOWER.title: SOPHIM Sunflower Oil
SOPHIMSUNFLOWER.supports: Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil; liquid emollient with balanced sensory description; conventional and high-oleic grades.
SOPHIMSUNFLOWER.limits: No comparative ranking, viscosity or hair-weight panel. 'Balanced' is weak supplier language.

SOPHIMOLIVE.title: SOPHIM Olive Oil
SOPHIMOLIVE.supports: Olea Europaea Fruit Oil; supplier emphasizes comfortable emollience; refined and virgin grades offered.
SOPHIMOLIVE.limits: No comparative weight ranking. Nutrient richness is not sensory richness.

CRODAWHEAT.title: Croda Cropure Wheatgerm
CRODAWHEAT.access: Public page retrieved; detailed data sheet login gated.
CRODAWHEAT.supports: Purified wheatgerm grade described as smooth on skin.
CRODAWHEAT.limits: Not a rich hair-class measurement; grade-specific.

O3WHEATPDF.title: O&3 Wheatgerm Oil Unrefined K0485 product information
O3WHEATPDF.supports: Supplier cautions thick unrefined wheatgerm oil may weigh down fine hair.
O3WHEATPDF.limits: No disclosed dose, panel or comparator. Conflicts with broad lightweight/absorption copy on another O&3 grade page.

O3WHEATWEB.title: O&3 Wheatgerm Oil Cold Pressed Organic K0483
O3WHEATWEB.access: Public page read; technical documents require contact form.
O3WHEATWEB.limits: Templated page wording conflicts with K0485 hair caution. Do not treat as independent measured evidence.

KUPANDA2021.title: Kupanda / GfN-Selco African natural oils presentation
KUPANDA2021.locator: PDF page 5, Marula Seed Oil Mfula #7339
KUPANDA2021.supports: Refined marula is described as quickly absorbed with matte satin skin feel.
KUPANDA2021.limits: Does not establish hair lightness. Contrasts with O&3's richer sensory description.

CRODACAMELLIA.title: Croda Cropure Yuchayu
CRODACAMELLIA.access: Public page read; detailed data sheet login gated.
CRODACAMELLIA.supports: Exact Camellia Oleifera Seed Oil identity, liquid and spreading-agent designation.
CRODACAMELLIA.limits: No comparative light/rich evidence. Does not authorize treating japonica, oleifera and sinensis as botanical synonyms.

O3CAMELLIA.title: O&3 Camellia Oil Japonica Refined Organic K0514
O3CAMELLIA.supports: Exact Camellia Japonica Seed Oil; supplier non-greasy hair-use description.
O3CAMELLIA.limits: No disclosed comparative study; does not transfer to leaf extract.

BLACKSEED2024.title: Comparative analysis of Nigella sativa oil extraction processes
BLACKSEED2024.access: Relevant full section available through indexed result; direct open failed.
BLACKSEED2024.supports: Fixed seed oils from pressing/solvent extraction described as fluid with light consistency.
BLACKSEED2024.limits: Descriptive material/skin language; no validated hair sensory protocol. Not essential oil or thymoquinone isolate.

BLACKSEED2016.title: Effects of extraction methods on black seed oil
BLACKSEED2016.supports: Study reports low viscosity at 25°C for its extraction samples.
BLACKSEED2016.limits: Oil/essential-oil terminology and volatile composition complicate exact commercial fixed-oil equivalence. Numeric values excluded from ranking.

RELE2003.title: Effect of mineral, sunflower and coconut oils on prevention of hair damage
RELE2003.access: PubMed abstract read; full protocol not accessed.
RELE2003.supports: Coconut reduced protein loss in tested pre/post-wash conditions; sunflower did not show that endpoint.
RELE2003.limits: Not sensory heaviness. Authors affiliated with Marico. Failure on protein-loss endpoint is not no cosmetic benefit.

KEIS2005.title: Investigation of penetration abilities of oils into human hair fibers
KEIS2005.access: PubMed abstract read; full protocol not accessed.
KEIS2005.supports: Time-dependent capillary adhesion changes for coconut, olive and sunflower; surface film thinning supported by instrumental measurements for coconut/sunflower.
KEIS2005.limits: Mechanistic laboratory endpoint, not standardized perceived heaviness; dose, heat and elapsed time matter.

MDPI2024.title: Natural or Synthetic Emollients? Physicochemical Properties of Body Oils
MDPI2024.access: Indexed methods/results read; direct page returned 429. Publisher PDF also discoverable.
MDPI2024.supports: At 22°C, tested grapeseed and almond were less viscous than tested macadamia; skin/body-oil study.
MDPI2024.limits: Reported castor near 100 mPa·s conflicts with refined Merck specification near 1000; unexplained sample/method discrepancy. No pooled numerical threshold; macadamia species is ternifolia, not integrifolia.

AAKVARIABILITY.title: AAK Performance without compromise
AAKVARIABILITY.locator: What to remember when choosing naturals
AAKVARIABILITY.supports: Origin, refining and processing can yield different material chemistry under the same INCI.
AAKVARIABILITY.limits: General material-selection guidance; does not assign classes.

PRAANWATERMELON.title: Praan Naturals Refined Watermelon Seed Oil Product Literature
PRAANWATERMELON.access: Indexed text reports light texture; initial PDF open produced metadata, subsequent content opens failed.
PRAANWATERMELON.supports: Light texture claim for refined watermelon seed oil.
PRAANWATERMELON.limits: No comparative hair panel; access limited to indexed description.

oils.name: Jojoba
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Liquid wax, not a triglyceride. A light prior is plausible from skin finish, not proven on hair.

oils.identity_limits: Do not match Jojoba Esters, Hydrolyzed Jojoba Esters, Hydrogenated Jojoba Oil, Isopropyl Jojobate or PEG derivatives.

oils.name: Grapeseed
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

evidence.observation: Lowest viscosity of four tested natural samples.

advisory_policy.rationale: Comparative skin feel supports the lower end among intact oils. It does not promise weightless hair.

oils.identity_limits: Seed oil only; exclude seed extract and hydrogenated/PEG derivatives.

oils.name: C8/C10 MCT
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Relatively fluid C8/C10 carrier supports light estimate against heavier intact oils; medium-spreading and nonvolatile limits remain.

oils.identity_limits: Not whole Cocos Nucifera Oil; not Triheptanoin (C7), Caprylic/Capric/Succinic Triglyceride, caprylate esters or generic fractionated coconut oil without exact INCI.

oils.name: Sweet almond
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

evidence.observation: Below macadamia in sampled viscosity comparison.

advisory_policy.rationale: Accept a light prior rather than declaring all kernel oils medium/rich; leave medium plausible for grade/application differences.

oils.identity_limits: Exclude seed extract, bitter almond essential oil, almond butter and hydrogenated carrier blends.

oils.name: Apricot kernel
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Prefer comparative panel's intermediate estimate; alternative is credible and explicit.

oils.identity_limits: Kernel oil only; not fruit extract, kernel extract or butter.

oils.name: Safflower
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Light is a supplier-informed working estimate, not a linoleic-acid deduction. High-oleic and high-linoleic grades remain unresolved by INCI.

oils.identity_limits: Exclude safflower oleosomes, phospholipid derivatives and extracts. INCI does not identify chemotype.

oils.name: Castor
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

evidence.observation: Much lower castor value; not reconciled.

advisory_policy.rationale: Rich is the most defensible material prior, but even this is not a validated universal hair class. Alternative matters mainly when dilution/dose changes context.

oils.identity_limits: Never transfer to Hydrogenated Castor Oil, PEG-40/60 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Ricinoleates, castor copolymers or Triheptanoin.

oils.name: Whole coconut
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

evidence.observation: Melts/spreads readily; relatively greasy skin afterfeel.

advisory_policy.rationale: Choose rich as a conservative immediate-residue estimate for intact oil, with medium plausible after warming, low dose or longer absorption. Penetration does not force a light class.

oils.identity_limits: Exclude MCT/fractionated derivatives, Coconut Alkanes, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, hydrogenated coconut oil and coconut extract.

oils.name: Argan
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Light is plausible for refined material from supplier skin finish. Medium is equally plausible for unspecified grade and hair exposure; no hard rank versus jojoba.

oils.identity_limits: Exclude kernel extract, argan butter and modified esters.

oils.name: Olive
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Medium is a tentative central emollience hypothesis grounded only weakly in sensory description; rich remains plausible. No verified comparative evidence here warrants a universal rich rule.

oils.identity_limits: Fruit oil only; exclude leaf extract, olive squalane, olivates, hydrogenated olive oil and unsaponifiables.

oils.name: Avocado
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Use medium for unspecified/refined material, rich for the plausible crude-grade alternative. Exact INCI alone cannot resolve it.

oils.identity_limits: Exclude avocado extract, butter, unsaponifiables and hydrogenated oil.

oils.name: Sunflower
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

evidence.observation: Balanced liquid emollient; oleic grades available.

advisory_policy.rationale: Tentative moderate film prior; light also plausible. Hair penetration/protein-loss results cannot decide weight. No linoleic shortcut.

oils.identity_limits: Seed oil only; exclude seed wax, extract, hydrogenated oil and high-oleic assumption from plain INCI.

oils.name: Macadamia
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

evidence.observation: Organic grade more fluid; text differs on stickiness.

advisory_policy.rationale: Comparative skin study supports intermediate rather than automatic rich. Grade variability persists.

oils.identity_limits: Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil is a distinct declared species, not an exact alias; similar prior requires an explicit separate mapping. Exclude Ethyl Macadamiate and hydrogenated derivatives.

oils.name: Hemp seed
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Combine fluid skin application with light supplier guidance; fluidity alone would not justify light hair feel.

oils.identity_limits: Seed oil only; exclude Cannabis Sativa Extract, CBD/cannabinoids and essential oils.

oils.name: Marula
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Medium is a compromise between positive conflicting sensory reports, not a missing-evidence fallback. Both alternatives must remain visible.

oils.identity_limits: Exclude marula esters, extracts and alkane blends.

oils.name: Baobab
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Two supplier lanes favor intermediate; light remains plausible on hair at small dose.

oils.identity_limits: Seed oil only; exclude extract, hydrolyzed seed protein and modified derivatives.

oils.name: Camellia
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Light estimate applies first to japonica. Camellia Oleifera Seed Oil may receive a separate low-confidence estimate; no automatic synonym expansion to all Camellia species.

oils.identity_limits: Do not alias Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract or any leaf extract. Japonica, oleifera and sinensis seed oils are separate botanical identities.

oils.name: Black seed / black cumin
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

evidence.observation: Fixed oils described as fluid/light consistency.

advisory_policy.rationale: A cautious light hypothesis is possible from descriptive material evidence, but it is among the weakest estimates; no quantitative hair ranking is supported.

oils.identity_limits: Only intact fixed seed oil; not essential oil, Nigella extract, thymoquinone or Carum Carvi Seed Oil.

oils.name: Wheat germ
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

evidence.observation: Unrefined grade may weigh down fine hair.

advisory_policy.rationale: Rich is cautious for unrefined material, not an INCI-invariant rule. Refined/unspecified grades admit medium/light; evidence is internally inconsistent.

oils.identity_limits: Exclude germ extract, hydrolyzed wheat protein and Wheat Germ Glycerides.

oils.name: Sea buckthorn fruit/pulp
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Rich is a weak supplier prior specific to pulp/fruit; colored or antioxidant-rich does not itself mean heavy.

oils.identity_limits: Do not transfer to Hippophae Rhamnoides Seed Oil, extracts or carrier macerates. Pulp Oil wording needs documented INCI identity.

oils.name: Watermelon seed
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Light is a supplier-supported estimate; no scientific hair ranking. Kalahari cultivar identity should remain explicit where provided.

oils.identity_limits: Seed oil only; not fruit extract; common watermelon and Kalahari materials may differ by cultivar/grade.

oils.name: Moringa
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Intermediate has positive supplier support; do not label rich solely because oleic acid is high.

oils.identity_limits: Seed oil only; exclude leaf/seed extracts, hydrogenated or modified oil.

oils.name: Babassu
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

evidence.observation: Soft solid below 24°C; melts on skin.

advisory_policy.rationale: Light after melting is plausible despite solid storage state; alternative medium/rich reflects temperature and hair residue uncertainty. Solid does not automatically equal rich.

oils.identity_limits: Exact Orbignya Oleifera identity only; not automatic Orbignya Speciosa/Attalea synonym expansion or babassu esters.

oils.name: Pomegranate seed
oils.material_form: intact oil unless identity limits specify otherwise

advisory_policy.rationale: Rich is supported comparatively for the tested crude grade; still extrapolated to hair.

oils.identity_limits: Seed oil only; exclude fruit extract, seed extract and modified derivatives.

remaining_uncertainty: No standardized equal-dose hair sensory comparator set recovered.
Multiple grades can share INCI; temperature, dose, substrate and elapsed time affect feel.
Univar 2018 and 2022 likely share evidence and cannot be counted as independent studies.
Marula, wheatgerm, apricot, crude/refined avocado show meaningful grade/source conflicts.
Black seed, olive and sunflower priors remain especially weak; no firm ingredient ordering is justified.
rejected_methods: Linoleic percent -> light or oleic percent -> rich.
Penetrates hair -> light; protein-loss protection -> rich/light.
Solid at room temperature -> necessarily heavy on hair.
Treating marketing 'rich in vitamins' or 'light yellow' as sensory evidence.
Pooling inconsistent cross-source viscosity values into numerical class thresholds.
